leadText:
Kalos Canyon (Japanese: カロスキャニオン Kalos Canyon) is an -exclusive location in Kalos. It is located in , between Geosenge Town and Shalour City. It was formed naturally over the course of tens of thousands of years.

The winds blowing through the ravines in the canyon turn into rising air currents, and as such it is an ideal spot for Sky Battles. There is a center nearby specially for Sky Battles, where s can rent Sky Battle wing suits and practice in air tubes. The actual Sky Battles are held over the canyon. 

In Battles in the Sky!, and paid a visit to the center, where they rented wing suits and enjoyed some practice flying before meeting Sky Battle instructor Moria. Later, Ash had his first Sky Battle at the canyon against Moria and her . He first used his , but lost. He then used , and managed to win when Fletchling evolved into .

In A Towering Takeover!, Grant was shown there, watching Lysandre's broadcast from Lumiose City.
